# PolyLance Zenith (formerly PolyLance)

> Official decentralized Web3 freelancing protocol on the Polygon blockchain. Formerly known as **PolyLance** (`polylance.codes`), now rebranded as **PolyLance Zenith** at `https://polylancezenith.com/`. (Distinct from Microsoft's Pylance Python extension.)

## Key Facts
- **Official Domain:** https://polylancezenith.com/
- **Legacy Domain:** https://polylance.codes/ (migrated to `polylancezenith.com`)
- **Brand Name:** PolyLance Zenith (formerly PolyLance; short name: PL Zenith)
- **Category:** Decentralized Web3 Freelancing Marketplace & Non-Custodial Milestone Escrow Protocol
- **Blockchain Network:** Polygon
- **Supported Settlement Currencies:** USDC and POL
- **Protocol Fee:** Flat 5% total (2.5% client + 2.5% freelancer)
- **Authentication:** Wallet-only sign-in (no email address, phone number, or seed phrase ever collected)
- **Reputation System:** Soulbound on-chain reputation certificates minted directly to the user's wallet
- **New Interface Reveal Date:** 17 December 2026 at 12:00 AM IST (16 December 2026 at 18:30 UTC)
